start: Online gym, owner signed in on a device that has opened a money sheet at least once while online; a member owes ₹1,500

steps.action: Open "Collect payment" for the member while online
user_sees: The normal sheet; nothing about offline is shown
must_not: A wait or an error while the device gets its own receipt series

steps.action: The internet goes. Type nothing in the amount box and take the cash
user_sees: The sheet stays as it is under the app's offline bar
must_not: The sheet closing or emptying

steps.action: Tap "Save payment"
user_sees: "Saving…", then the sheet closes
"Payment saved on this device. Receipt <this device's own number>. It goes online when the internet is back."
must_not: "Payment saved." with no word that it is only on this device
A receipt number that another desk could also give

steps.action: Print or show the receipt; later the internet comes back
user_sees: The payment goes online once, with the same receipt number
must_not: A second receipt for the same payment
The receipt number changing after it was printed

start: Online gym, owner; the internet is off; a member wants to renew

steps.action: Open "Renew membership" (or "Sell membership"), pick the plan, type the money received and confirm
user_sees: "Membership saved on this device. Receipt <this device's own number>. It goes online when the internet is back."
must_not: A membership saved with its money lost
A normal online receipt number given offline

steps.action: Internet back
user_sees: The membership and its receipt go online once
must_not: Two memberships

start: Online gym, owner; the internet is off; Money, Dues list

steps.action: Tap "Collect" on a row, leave the amount blank, tap "Save payment"
user_sees: The sheet closes
Only "Payment saved." (the code gives this page no other words)
must_not: The person at the desk not being told the payment is only on this device and what its receipt number is

start: Online gym, owner, on a device that has NOT opened a money sheet online since this feature came

steps.action: With the internet off, open "Collect payment" and tap "Save payment"
user_sees: "Connect this device to the internet once so it can take payments offline. Until then, take this payment when the internet is back."
The sheet stays open; nothing is saved
must_not: A receipt with a made-up or clashing number
A success message

steps.action: On a device whose storage is full, with the internet off, tap "Save payment"
user_sees: "Nothing was saved: this device is out of space. Free up space, or try again when the internet is back."
must_not: A success message for a payment that was not kept

steps.action: With the internet off, try something that is not kept offline, such as "Freeze / extra days"
user_sees: The button cannot be pressed, or "No internet, so this can't be saved now. Check-ins, payments and new members still work. Try this again when the internet is back."
must_not: A change that looks saved and is lost

start: Online gym, owner; the connection is weak: a save is sent and no answer comes back

steps.action: Tap "Save payment"; the answer never arrives
user_sees: A message that it could not be confirmed; the sheet stays open
must_not: A success message for a save nobody confirmed

steps.action: Tap "Save payment" again in the same sheet
user_sees: "A payment for this member is still being sent. When the internet is back, check the member's page before you take money again."
must_not: A second receipt for the same money

steps.action: Change the amount in the same sheet and tap again after the first one did save
user_sees: "Your earlier entry was saved just now (receipt <number>). Check the member’s page before you take money again."
must_not: The changed amount saved as a second payment

steps.action: Internet back; open the member page
user_sees: One receipt; the due is down once
must_not: The due reduced twice

steps.action: Sign out and in again on the same device while a payment is still waiting
user_sees: Unknown from the code read: the waiting payment must still be there and go online
must_not: A waiting payment dropped at sign-out
